title: Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO Details
intro:
Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO is a book build issue of ₹60.98 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 0.46 crore shares of ₹60.98 crore.

Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 14, 2026 and will close on Aug 18, 2026. The allotment for the Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 19, 2026. Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 21, 2026.

Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO is set issue price band at ₹125 to ₹132 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,64,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,96,000.

Rarever Financial Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Aftertrade Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1994, Technocrats Plasma Systems Ltd. is an engineering-focused company engaged in providing plasma-based surface treatment and coating solutions for industrial applications. The company designs, develops, and installs plasma systems used for surface cleaning, activation, coating, and modification across diverse manufacturing sectors. Its services include system customization, installation, commissioning, maintenance support, and technical consulting, helping clients improve product performance, durability, and process efficiency.

The company develop the products through in-house research and development and engineering. Their teams handle mechanical, electrical and control design for plasma cutting machines, welding equipment and automation systems, which helps them retain design knowhow within the Company and maintain confidentiality.

The company have two manufacturing facilities located at Vasai, both are situated within the Gaodevi Industrial Estate. The first unit was established at Gala No. 6,7,8 & 1st floor 106,107,108, Gaodevi Industrial Estate, Sativali, Vasai (E) (Unit-I) and the second unit was added in Gala No. 105, First floor, Nirav No. 2, Gaodevi Industrial Estate, Sativali, Vasai (E) (Unit-II).
As of June 30, 2026, they had an employee base of 40 employees.
strengths: Experience across industries, installed base and diversified customer base
Indigenous design and in-house fabrication with cost and schedule control
Product and solution range with customisation and lifecycle service
Operations, quality assurance and employee training

The company posted growth in its top and bottom lines for the reported periods. However, the boosted top and bottom lines for FY26 appears to be a window dressing for fancy valuations of the IPO. Based on its recent average financial data, the issue appears aggressively priced. Only well-informed/risk takers may park moderate fund for long term. Read detail review... faqs.question: How to apply in Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Technocrats Plasma Systems IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
